in_hebrew.name: Yvor
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Yvor הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'Ivōr', meaning 'yarrow' or 'warrior'. In ancient Greece, yarrow was a medicinal herb used to heal wounds and calm the mind. The name Yvor reflects the strength and resilience of a warrior, as well as the nurturing and healing qualities of the herb.
